# openbim-ifc

Facade for the openBIM IFC crates: pick codecs and domains as features.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Status | <span class="status-implemented">Implemented</span> |
| Latest release | 0.38.0 (2026-10-27) |
| Registries | [crates.io `openbim-ifc`](https://crates.io/crates/openbim-ifc) |

## Overview

`ifc` — the facade. Pick your codecs and domains as cargo features.

## Features

| Feature | Default | What it enables |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alignment` |  | [`ifc-alignment`](./ifc-alignment): IFC4x3 linear positioning: alignments, referents, linear placement, spirals. |
| `approval` |  | [`ifc-approval`](./ifc-approval): Bounded IFC4 approval resource semantics. |
| `author` |  | Schema-checked authoring (`authoring`) with every bundled release (`schema`). |
| `authoring` |  | Schema-checked authoring (`ifc-author`) and the checked authoring batch (`apply_authoring`), against the releases the build names. |
| `classification` |  | [`ifc-classification`](./ifc-classification): Classification systems, document references, libraries, external references. |
| `codecs` |  | Both codecs: STEP and ifcXML. |
| `colour` |  | The surface colour of each product's Body (`product_colours`): the item's styled item, its styled presentation layer, else its material's styled representation (layer, profile and constituent sets resolved per item), with the source and a typed refusal. Kernel-free. |
| `constraint` |  | [`ifc-constraint`](./ifc-constraint): Bounded IFC4 metric, objective, and constraint relationships. |
| `control` |  | [`ifc-control`](./ifc-control): Bounded IFC control semantics: permits, project orders, action requests, and performance history. |
| `cost` |  | [`ifc-cost`](./ifc-cost): Cost semantics as a borrowed view over the IFC model. |
| `domains` |  | Every domain view, plus authoring and spatial traversal. |
| `element-type` |  | [`ifc-element-type`](./ifc-element-type): Element, resource, and process type definitions: the IfcTypeObject catalogue. |
| `full` |  | Everything: codecs and ifcZIP, schema tables, every domain, catalogues, geometry and meshes, georeferencing and alignment. |
| `geometry` |  | Representation selection plus lowering into the neutral geometry DAG. |
| `geometry-select` |  | Representation selection only: contexts, plan/body choice, placements and units, with no geometry kernel. |
| `geometry-wire` |  | Each product's Body as Axiolid's neutral geometry graph (`product_graphs`), exact and in world metres, encodable in Axiolid's versioned wire format (1.0; 1.1 where a station carries a seam-snapping window, 1.2 where a run's sections do, 1.3 where an offset run continues to a basis end the kernel measures, 1.4 where a polygonal bounded half-space clips) as JSON or CBOR (`ifc::geometry::wire`); a typed refusal per product. Computes nothing; adds the lowering and serde. |
| `georef` |  | [`ifc-georef`](./ifc-georef): Georeferencing: map conversion, coordinate reference systems, site placement. |
| `ifc2x3` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC2X3 TC1 table. |
| `ifc4` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC4 ADD2 TC1 table. |
| `ifc4x1` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC4X1 FINAL table. |
| `ifc4x2` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC4X2 FINAL table. |
| `ifc4x3` |  | The schema API with the bundled IFC4X3 ADD2 table. |
| `ifcxml` |  | [`ifc-xml`](./ifc-xml): ifcXML (ISO 10303-28) codec for the IFC model. |
| `js-random` |  | Random `GlobalId`s (`new_guid`) and batch seeds (`fresh_seed`) on `wasm32-unknown-unknown` from the JavaScript host's `crypto.getRandomValues`; without it both refuse there; native targets always have them. |
| `material` |  | [`ifc-material`](./ifc-material): Material definitions: layer sets, profile sets, constituents, usage. |
| `material-templates` |  | Material views together with the property template catalogue. |
| `mesh` |  | Triangle meshes per product (`product_meshes`, `product_meshes_for` a representation purpose, with solid or surface closure) and polylines of curve representations (`product_curves`: Axis, FootPrint, annotation curves, each with a certified chord bound) through `ifc-geometry`'s reference compile backend: positions relative to each product's world placement, its surface colour (`colour`), a typed refusal per product. Opt-in; links an execution provider (ADR 0004, ADR 0012). |
| `occurrence` |  | [`ifc-occurrence`](./ifc-occurrence): Built element and distribution occurrence classes and their type pairing. |
| `properties` |  | Property sets, quantities and unit resolution (`ifc-properties`); together with `geometry-select`, door and window operation geometry; together with `spatial`, element properties by spatial container. |
| `property-catalog` |  | The PSD/QTO template catalogue (`ifc-template-catalog`), every edition embedded. |
| `property-catalog-runtime` |  | The PSD/QTO template catalogue installed at runtime from pinned per-edition snapshot files; nothing embedded. |
| `resource` |  | [`ifc-resource`](./ifc-resource): Construction resources: labour, equipment, material, crew, subcontract. |
| `schedule` |  | [`ifc-schedule`](./ifc-schedule): IFC scheduling: IfcTask/IfcWorkSchedule, sequencing, 4D linkage. |
| `schema` |  | The schema API with every bundled release (IFC2X3, IFC4, IFC4X1, IFC4X2, IFC4X3). |
| `schema-api` |  | The schema API without a bundled release; implied by each release feature. |
| `selector` |  | The selector query language (`ifc::selector`, grammar 1.0): filter elements by class, `GlobalId`, attribute, property, type, material, classification, location and group, with typed parse errors carrying byte spans; read and write values by path (`type.Name`, `Pset_WallCommon.FireRating`) through a checked transaction. Property facets need `properties` too. |
| `sheet` |  | Tables of values by path (`ifc::sheet`, #474): export selected entities by attribute, property, quantity and relation paths as CSV or TSV, and import a table back by `GlobalId` or id as one checked transaction, with a planned diff and typed refusals by row and column. |
| `sheet-xlsx` |  | `sheet` with XLSX workbooks too, through the pure-Rust `rust_xlsxwriter` (write) and `calamine` (read) crates. |
| `spatial` |  | [`ifc-spatial`](./ifc-spatial): IFC spatial containment and objectified relationship traversal: project, site, building, storey, element. |
| `step` | yes | [`ifc-step`](./ifc-step): STEP physical file (ISO 10303-21) codec for the IFC model. |
| `structural` |  | [`ifc-structural`](./ifc-structural): Structural analysis model: members, connections, actions, reactions, loads. |
| `style` |  | [`ifc-style`](./ifc-style): Presentation: styles, colours, textures, layers, annotation. |
| `systems` |  | [`ifc-systems`](./ifc-systems): Distribution systems, ports, and connectivity between elements. |
| `tabular` |  | [`ifc-tabular`](./ifc-tabular): Structured IFC value containers indexed by position or time. |
| `validate` |  | [`ifc-validate`](./ifc-validate): Schema conformance: WHERE rules, cardinality, GUID and reference integrity. |
| `validate-express` |  | Validation (`validate`) with the EXPRESS rule evaluator (`ifc::validate::express`): every WHERE rule, type rule and global rule of a release, evaluated from the `.exp` text the caller supplies (#461). |
| `zip` |  | ifcZIP (`ifc::ifczip`, `ifc::ifczip::IfcZipCodec`): read an archive holding one STEP or ifcXML model within a decompression budget, and write one; Stored and Deflate only, through the pure-Rust `zip` and `flate2` (miniz_oxide) crates. |

## Changes

Latest release, 0.38.0 (2026-10-27):

### Changed (breaking) (#573)

- `fresh_seed()` returns `Result<u128, GuidError>`, drawn from `new_guid`'s
  source: the operating system natively, `crypto.getRandomValues` on
  `wasm32-unknown-unknown` with `js-random`. Without `js-random` there it
  refuses with `GuidError::NoRandomSource`; a host without a generator
  (Node 18) gives `GuidError::RandomSourceFailed`.

### Fixed (#573)

- On `wasm32-unknown-unknown` `fresh_seed` was a counter from 0 per page
  load, so a model reopened in a new session drew seeds it already held and
  its first edit was refused with `SeedReused`.

Semver: breaking (minor while 0.x), released in 0.38.0 with #548 and #559.

### Added (#566)

- `release_catalog(SchemaVersion) -> Result<Catalog, ReleaseCatalogError>`
  and `release_edition(SchemaVersion) -> Option<CatalogEdition>`, behind
  `schema-api` (any release feature) and `property-catalog` or
  `property-catalog-runtime`: the PSD/QTO catalog a release reads -- IFC2X3
  TC1 as published, IFC4 ADD2 TC1 and IFC4X3 ADD2 corrected -- the policy
  property edits and `validate` now share, so an authoring check made before
  a product exists cannot disagree with them. `ReleaseCatalogError` is
  `NoCatalog`, `NotInstalled { edition }` or `Unreadable { edition, reason }`.

### Fixed (#565)

- Through the re-exported `AuthorError`: an enumeration constant that is not
  a member of the declared release's enumeration is refused with
  `NotEnumerationMember` (`ifc-author`). A cross-release append surfaces it
  as `IncompatibleRelease` (bindings: unsupported-schema); build, set and
  copy report an invalid value.

### Changed (breaking) (#465)

- Through the re-exported `Model`: `header_mut` bumps the revision, so a
  `Transaction` opened before a header edit is refused at commit with
  `Conflict::StaleRevision`; revisions are process-unique rather than
  per-model counters, so a transaction or inverse made against another model
  is refused (`ifc-model` 0.4.0).

### Added (#465)

- Re-exports `History`, `HistoryError`, `Inverse`, `InverseError` and
  `Restored` from `ifc-model`: `History::track` around `apply_authoring`
  (or any change) makes it undoable with byte-identical restoration.

### Changed (#559)

- The `GlobalId`s a property edit derives for the sets and relationships it
  creates derive from a caller seed, the object's `GlobalId`, the set name,
  the record's role and its count among the batch's records of that object,
  set and role, no longer from the model's next free id. The same edits
  under the same seed give the same `GlobalId`s after a write/read cycle
  that shifts the next id, so a journal of property edits replays to the
  same identities.
- `stage_property_edits` and `apply_property_edits` take that `seed`, and
  so does every write that may create a set: `SelectorIndex::stage_set_value`,
  `selector::set_value`, `SelectorIndex::plan_text_edits`,
  `selector::apply_text_edits`, `sheet::plan_import` and `sheet::import`
  (an attribute write ignores it).
- `fresh_seed` is available in every build, no longer only with `authoring`.

### Added (#559)

- `PropertyEditFailure::SeedReused`, raised when a derived `GlobalId` is
  held by an entity the batch leaves in the model (the seed named an
  earlier batch's records). A seed may edit other objects or sets, and may
  be used again once its records are removed.

Semver: breaking (minor while 0.x), released with #548 in 0.38.0: the
property-edit, selector-write and sheet-import entry points take a seed,
the same edit of the same file no longer gives the same `GlobalId`s, and
`SeedReused` is a new variant of the `#[non_exhaustive]` `PropertyEditFailure`.

### Changed (#548)

- The `GlobalId`s a batch derives (an `IfcRoot` created without one, every
  relationship a builder writes, copies) derive from the seed, the
  operation's position in the batch, the created entity's type and its
  count among that type in the operation, no longer from the entity id; an
  `apply_append` derives from the seed, the type and the count. The same
  seed and operations give the same `GlobalId`s after a write/read cycle
  that shifts the next id, so a journal of batches replays to the same
  identities. An `AssignType` that joins an existing relationship derives
  none.

### Added (#548)

- `AuthoringFailure::SeedReused`, raised when a derived `GlobalId` is held
  by an entity of the model (the seed named an earlier batch). A seed whose
  entities were all removed may be used again.

Semver: breaking (minor while 0.x): a fixed seed gives other `GlobalId`s than
0.37.0, and a batch that reuses a seed may now be refused; `SeedReused` is a
new variant of the `#[non_exhaustive]` `AuthoringFailure`. The hosts draw a
fresh seed per batch (the browser from `Math.random`).

### Fixed (#534)

- `AuthorOp::AssignType` on a type that already has an
  `IfcRelDefinesByType` adds the objects to that relationship's
  `RelatedObjects` instead of creating a second one, which broke
  `IfcTypeObject.Types SET [0:1]` (`ObjectTypeOf` in IFC2X3). The op
  produces the existing relationship's id, and `owner_history` applies
  only to a relationship that is created. An object typed by another type
  is still refused unless `replace`. A relationship whose `RelatedObjects`
  is not a list is refused with `InvalidRelationship`, not rewritten.

### Added (#537)

- `ReleaseCatalog` gives `ifc-validate` the member templates of the
  embedded or installed PSD/QTO catalog, so `validate` reports
  `property.undeclared_member` and `property.member_type` warnings for
  the members of a catalog set. A set kind the build does not know gives no
  template, and its members are reported as not checked.

Semver: minor; it re-exports `ifc-validate` 0.8.0 and its new findings.

### Fixed (#537)

- The property writer's template check accepts any type a declared SELECT
  (`IfcValue`) closes over, as `validate` does; it refused them before.

### Changed (#539, tests)

Semver: no release on its own. No code change.

- The #469 corpus test `length_unit_corpus.rs` sums mesh volumes about
  each body's first vertex rather than the world origin, where triple
  products at georeferenced coordinates cancelled catastrophically. The
  29 products it skipped as ill-conditioned (blamed on booleans decided
  by the last bit) were that measuring artefact: the skip list is
  removed, and all 181 meshed products are compared and agree after
  converting to feet.
